name: Draconic Fumecrux

items.name: Desiccated Boulder Breath
items.text:
The draconic fumecrux belches forth a mass of stones that are partially solid and partially void energy. These stones deal 4d8 bludgeoning,4d8 void damage in a 30-foot cone (DC 25 basic Reflex save save).

It can't use Desiccated Boulder Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

items.name: Hellfume Body
items.text: A fumecrux's body consists of hellish fumes infused with void energy. When a creature that's holding its breath while it has been Swallowed Whole by a fumecrux attacks or casts a spell on a turn, the creature loses 3 rounds of air instead of 2.

items.name: Spit Up
items.text:
Requirements The draconic fumecrux has a creature Swallowed Whole

---
Effect The draconic fumecrux spits out the swallowed creature, flinging it through the air up to 40 feet away. The creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to the distance it traveled and lands Prone. If it lands in the same space as another creature, the other creature is pushed 5 feet and takes 3d8+4 bludgeoning damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save save). The fumecrux can't Spit Up more than one creature at a time no matter their size, and the most recently swallowed creature is Spit Up first.

text:
This creature is the result of the fumecrux ritual performed on the head of a young adamantine dragon. Unlike most fumecruxes, draconic fumecruxes retain some of the unique magic of their living counterparts.

---
By studying the phenomena of hellcrowns and beheaded, Chelaxian mages have created a fusion of the two. Years of experimentation culminated in the creation of fumecruxes, brimstone specters capped with the decapitated and rotting heads of great beasts. The process is being attempted more frequently as yet another weapon for the war against Andoran.
